reviews.text: I have a sensitive skin with rosacea and this type of peeling I only use. The texture is soft but the formula is very good
reviews.zh: 我有敏感性皮膚加上玫瑰痤瘡，去角質呢類產品我淨係用呢款。質地柔軟，但配方好好用。

reviews.text: So far it’s good. No irritation and after using it I feel my skin is soo soo smooth. I research online that this is not that strong but at the same time not very light. So just in the middle- I like how my skin feels after using.
reviews.zh: 用到依家都幾好。完全冇刺激感，用完之後覺得皮膚超超超滑。我上網做過功課，呢款唔算好強效，但又唔係好弱雞，剛剛好中間——我幾鍾意用完之後皮膚嗰種感覺。

reviews.text: It’s not very good at exfoliating or peeling, it feels like you’re rubbing wet tissue on your face. It did not cause any reaction to my skin so it seems very gentle which is nice. I will use it up but will not repurchase o
reviews.zh: 去角質同死皮嘅效果都唔算好，感覺好似用濕紙巾喺塊面度捽。皮膚完全冇任何反應，睇嚟真係好溫和，呢一點係好嘅。我會用完佢，但唔會再回購 o

reviews.text: This is a great face exfoliator! It's gentle enough for the face, but you can feel that it's actually helping to remove dead skin and grime from your face. It's not strong enough for most of the rest of your skin, so only buy this for your face!
reviews.zh: 呢款係一款好正嘅面部去角質產品！佢夠晒溫和可以用喺塊面，但同時真係感受到佢幫助清走面部嘅老廢角質同污垢。對身體其他大部份皮膚嚟講就唔夠強，所以只係畀面部用！

reviews.text: The best exfoliator I've ever used. Makes my skin feel so soft, and removes blackheads. Super gentle, never hurts my skin. I love it.
reviews.zh: 我用過最好用嘅去角質產品。用完皮膚變得好柔軟，仲去到黑頭。超級溫和，從來都唔會整痛皮膚。我好鍾意。

reviews.text: It's a great peeling. It may be the best I've ever had. My face felt smooth and fresh. It's effective and you don't have to use a big amount of product. I must say it smells great, which makes me use it more willingly.
reviews.zh: 呢款去角質產品真係好正。可能係我用過最讚嘅一款。用完塊面平滑又清爽。效果好又唔使搽好多份量。我仲要讚吓，佢味道好聞，用起上嚟都更加樂意。

reviews.text: Similar to BOJ apricot peel. This is a good product but I prefer the BHA product in this line better.
reviews.zh: 類似 BOJ 杏果去角質。呢款都係好產品，但我更鍾意同一條線嘅 BHA 產品。

reviews.text: Compared to the Dr G Brightening Peeling Gel, this is more my cup of tea. I enjoyed how it really goes deep down to exfoliate and leaves my skin smooth. Love! 😍
reviews.zh: 同 Dr G Brightening Peeling Gel 比起嚟，呢款更加啱我。我好享受佢真係深入去角質嘅感覺，用完皮膚滑溜滑溜。好鍾意！😍

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
